query:
SELECT b.id, u.name as studentName, mp.userId as mentorUserId, u2.name as mentorName, b.scheduledAt, b.consultationType, b.totalAmount, b.status
FROM bookings b
JOIN users u ON b.studentId = u.id
JOIN mentor_profiles mp ON b.mentorId = mp.id
JOIN users u2 ON mp.userId = u2.id
WHERE u.email = 'test-mentee@test.com'
ORDER BY b.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 1;
